items.title: Morgan Stanley Ethereum and Solana ETFs outperform rivals as second-day inflows reach $33 million
items.whyYouShouldCare: The strong inflows into Solana ETFs indicate growing institutional interest, which could enhance liquidity and market positioning for SOL.

items.title: ‘The CLARITY Act delivers what the American crypto ecosystem needs’ – Solana Policy Institute
items.whyYouShouldCare: The CLARITY Act could provide regulatory clarity, potentially fostering a more robust ecosystem for Solana and improving its attractiveness to developers and investors.

items.title: $1.1B stolen from crypto in 6 months: Ethereum and Solana lost $658M combined
items.whyYouShouldCare: The significant losses in crypto security highlight vulnerabilities in the ecosystem, which could impact user confidence and liquidity for Solana and Ethereum.
